verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing supports balance accounts, with a pooled balance or balances per card. Payment-event and transfer webhooks report in real time when funds are added to or deducted from balance accounts, a Report webhook type exists, and card payments are viewable in the Customer Area. However, nothing in the evidence shows a ledger that links each authorization to its clearing, or settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny. Missing for 10: authorization-to-clearing transaction linkage, settlement/reconciliation report documentation, real-time balance-query detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
